rootCause: clasp v3 project discovery can inherit an existing parent .clasp.json; clone/rootDir behavior made the temporary workspace non-isolated.
correctiveAction: Stop using clasp clone. Create an isolated .clasp.json per PRE/WORK/FRESH/POST/ROLLBACK workspace and invoke clasp pull/push with an explicit --project path.
businessRule: PreInspection only: Calendar organizer email -> exact Striven Employee -> RequestedBy.Type=employee; no customer-contact fallback.
